newsitem.title: UK: Qatar tells OPEC it over quota in December - OPECN.
newsitem.headline: Qatar tells OPEC it over quota in December - OPECN.

text.p: Tiny Qatar, OPEC's smallest oil producer, told the organisation it produced over its individual quota in December, The OPEC News Agency reported.
Middle East Gulf member Qatar told the Vienna-based Secretariat it produced 394,100 barrels per day (bpd) last month, up from its quota of 378,000 bpd.
But it supplied 381,700 bpd to the market, Qatar said.

OPEC sets its quota according to supply to the market and not by wellhead production. Supply, as defined by OPEC, is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawals of stocks held outside national boundaries.
Most OPEC member countries tell OPEC they produce within their quotas but independent surveys show most of the 11-member group over quota.
